title: Emerald Cave Paddleboard Rentals Near Las Vegas at Willow Beach
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Min age: 13 minors must be accompanied by an adult at all times
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Book your self-guided paddleboard rental and experience one of the the most unforgettable outdoor adventures near Las Vegas as you paddle to the world famous Emerald Cave on the Colorado River.

This self-guided adventure, located one hour from the Las Vegas Strip, launches from Willow Beach and takes you through the calm, crystal-clear waters of the majestic Colorado River while you paddle through the awe-inspiring towering walls of the Black Canyon.

Perfect for beginners and active travelers your rental includes a high quality inflatable paddleboard, life jacket, drybag, safety orientation and directions to Emerald Cave.

Paddle as long as you want up to 5 hours with plenty of time to explore, take photos, discover local wildlife and experience the glowing green waters inside Emerald Cave. 

Widely considered the top outdoor day trip from Las Vegas, this half-day adventure offers a peaceful escape from the city into the most stunning scenery in the Southwest.
